name: @papertree/ui
description: The reader's shared components. Owns the provenance register: the reserved ⊙ marker, derived_from block ids and the show-source affordance are implemented HERE so no surface can render derived content without them.
//sideEffects: The stylesheet is the ONLY side-effecting module here, and it is imported for its side effect
by definition. Under a bare `false` a bundler is entitled to drop `import
'@papertree/ui/styles.css'` entirely — and the failure is silent and looks like a missing
class, not like a dropped import. Every .ts/.tsx module remains tree-shakeable.
